scope: Controlled GUI-coordinate model with asynchronous engine collaborator; not browser input/audio, native, hardware or vendor equivalence.

tests.name: Synced +20% at ±8% starts centered; one GUI step changes pitch by 0.1%, not 12.1%
Ordinary GUI tempo remains absolute and accepts external rate changes while focused
External shared or MIDI tempo changes rebase the next GUI step at the last GUI position
REL disengagement, absolute hardware reset, range changes and replacement tracks retain valid coordinates
Rapid GUI gestures accumulate while audio work is pending
Transport saturation consumes overshoot; reversing by one GUI step moves immediately
Rejected rate changes rebase at actual audio state and permit a subsequent gesture
Reset sets actual pitch to zero; unloaded decks never request audio changes
